reviews.reason: Internal examination and relative drying measurements already cover tissue condition and water loss, but neither establishes digestibility, nutritional value or toxin absence. A missing, feasible precursor is a controlled aqueous-extractability experiment with an independently performed known-food comparison. It can establish limited physical processing behavior, not food safety. Specific nutrient or hazard detection additionally requires a validated analyte-specific method, appropriate controls and physically obtained apparatus; none is established here. No tasting is required.
reviews.experienceReview: The potential benefit is understanding gained from a successful experiment, not edibility reassurance or mastery. Subscribe qualifying extraction-reading/extraction-completed events to the existing information-confirmed mechanism: only the performing actor, after a paid, valid measurement establishes a previously unresolved physical property beyond uncertainty, receives confirmed-understanding feedback. Reuse its single functional source: transient amount 0.8, cap 1, duration 8 rounds, refresh repetition with a 12-round cooldown; maintained gain 0.035, decay 0.0015 per round, shared cap 1, only upon qualifying continued experimentation. Deduplicate by specimen lineage, property and supported conditions across all interfaces. Existing findings, inconclusive readings, requests, learning and labels award nothing. No separate pleasure or safety-relief source is warranted by this potentially tedious and inconclusive assay; hunger, health and protected mental accounts remain unchanged.
reviews.visualReview: Show the actual two located cups, allocated food portions, water levels, mixing and transfer progress, occupied tray regions, drying residues, leakage deposits and any clay contamination or vessel collapse. Bind presentation to the declared extraction events and existing water/drying events. Measurement overlays distinguish observed intervals, declared model assumptions and unresolved hazards; display an explicit 'not a safety or nutrition certificate' limitation. Replay retains paid stage transitions, exact transfers, losses, uncertainty and cancellation outcomes rather than depicting an automatic successful laboratory test.
reviews.specification:
Implement noningestive-extractability@1 through the current conversation handoff. Reuse existing food examination, water access, calibrated weighing and drying code separately from this new experimental function. Individual prerequisites: food-assay, measured-food-preservation and access-water mastery; their existing dependencies remain applicable. No equipment, water, reference food or mastery is supplied.
Public strict schema: {mode: inspect|prepare|read|resume|cancel|remove, project:string, sample:string, reference:string, water:string, apparatus:string[], quantityTenths:integer>=0, waterMl:integer>=0}. References use exact persistent IDs or one item:/object: prefix, never resource aliases. Inspect requires an accessible subject and zero unused quantities; prepare requires distinct owned sample/reference allocations, positive quantities, actual retained water and explicitly named calibrated balance, original comparison weights, drying tray and two intact cups. Other modes name the existing personal project and leave unused fields empty/zero. Publish eligible apparatus roles, capacities and uncertainty before allocation.
Physical scope: compare actual water extraction and subsequent dried residue from unknown food and a personally evidenced known-food reference; the reference does not transfer safety. Add a versioned conservative physical partition model for root/tuber tissue: initial water fraction 0.75, with 0.20 of dry matter water-extractable. These are declared simulation assumptions, not actor measurements or nutrient identities. Preserve existing food composition, age, processing history and water already represented; initialize only previously absent fields, never overwrite measured or processed composition. Extraction moves conserved dry material between tissue and liquid, not nutrition or toxins out of existence. Unsupported composition remains unassayable until its physical model is supplied. Neither soluble nor insoluble material is automatically digestible, nutritious, harmless or detoxified.
Inspect costs one round/0.2 energy. Preparation has four attended stages at 0.5 energy each: baseline weighing, water allocation, mixing/contact, and physical separation into the tray. Each arm needs water mass at least twice allocated dry mass and must fit actual cup/tray capacity. Both arms receive separately allocated materials and paid handling. Contact requires two elapsed rounds after mixing; extraction approaches its modeled limit by half the remaining extractable amount per wet round. Separation transfers only actual free liquid and suspended material, retaining measured transfer losses. No filter, sterile vessel, heating or selective chemistry is implied. Cups retain their existing leakage, wall erosion and collapse behavior. Leaked solids and clay contamination enter located deposits or retained mixtures; unmeasured contamination or losses can invalidate an extractability estimate. Residue drying uses existing weather, tray occupancy and deterioration mechanisms. Each read costs 0.2 energy plus existing weighing costs for every actual weighing. Report interval estimates; a quantitative conclusion requires two paid stable residue readings, supported baseline measurements and differences exceeding combined uncertainty. Otherwise return an inconclusive result with the actual limiting factor.
Persist exact allocations, composition lineage, apparatus identities, location, elapsed contact, measurements, uncertainty, paid stages, remaining work and owner. Use shared interaction reach 0.65, actual clear access segments, apparatus collision geometry and geometric capacities. No remote transfers or virtual surfaces. Insufficient energy/access pauses attended work without charge; weather, spoilage and cup leakage continue physically. Resume executes only remaining work. Completion is terminal; repetition creates a newly paid allocation. Cancellation or death terminates the controller and releases surviving escrow once at its actual location, retaining mixtures, damage and provenance; never clone, erase or refund consumed material. Installed passive material persists without an active owner controller.
Declare extraction-inspected, extraction-progress, extraction-reading, extraction-completed, extraction-invalidated and extraction-stopped for validated subscriptions. Completion records measured extractability only, unresolved nutritional and hazard questions, and method limitations. Specific hazard tests must remain unavailable until a concrete physical detection mechanism, independently checkable positive/negative controls, sensitivity and interference limits exist; no generic hazard-screen result. Preserve historical records and register new schemas and physical-model revision without changing prior findings. Review and implementation advance no simulation time.

review: Implements Sol actual round-330 request and world-212 review as a conserved two-arm physical extraction precursor, not a hazard detector. Four personal study rounds require this run food-assay, measured-food-preservation and access-water mastery. Exact references, five apparatus roles, a known-food personal reference, real retained cup water, clear local access, distinct cup footprints, capacities and energy are checked before allocation. Four handling stages are paid separately for each arm (eight half-energy stages total, including baseline weighing), followed by real elapsed contact, actual free-liquid transfer and two disjoint tray regions using existing weather drying. Existing represented composition/history/age are retained; only absent root/tuber composition uses the reviewed 0.75 water/0.20 dry extractability law. Solids, original nutrient/toxin accounts, retained film, leakage deposits, water, wall erosion and atmospheric exchange remain auditable; analytical material is not automatically edible. Existing porous cups and unresolved contamination cannot support a quantitative extractability, nutritional or safety conclusion: paid interval readings report the actual limits, and two stable readings terminate an inconclusive result without information/practice reward. Missing energy/access preserves paid work; JSON resume does not resolve a substitute for fully consumed original sources. Unattended contact/weather continue, cancellation/death releases surviving altered material once, and cup collapse retains constituents. Nine new regressions and the related water/preservation suite pass; current types, lint, architecture/build pass. Three final isolated browser images were personally inspected after fixing missing same-round status and overlapping labels, then copied to execution-plan evidence. The enlarged tray and retained water are explicit isolated fixtures, never formal resources or discoveries. Current pending installed-input diagnostics are 53273/58050/58840 characters against the unchanged 60000 cap; this is limited headroom, not long-horizon context certification. A format-only contact-execution change is included at this stopped source boundary; all historical snapshots remain unchanged. Full unfiltered tests and exact reconstruction of all 330 previous rounds remain mandatory before activation. This is attempt 20/20; no budget addition or policy adjustment is requested.
